capability_defaults.support_notes: Register semantics are corroborated by the EASUN SMX-II 3.6 kW easun-modbus implementation and the community SRNE/EASUN SMX-II ESPHome map. The 24 V model stores battery-voltage thresholds in 0.2 V wire increments. A write is accepted only after an exact-register read-back.

capabilities.title: Output Priority
capabilities.change_summary: Chooses the preferred source for the inverter output.

capabilities.title: Charger Source Priority
capabilities.change_summary: Chooses which source charges the battery.

capabilities.title: Output Frequency
capabilities.change_summary: Sets the nominal AC output frequency.

capabilities.title: AC Input Voltage Range
capabilities.change_summary: Chooses appliance or UPS AC input limits.

capabilities.title: Output Voltage
capabilities.change_summary: Sets the nominal AC output voltage.

capabilities.title: Maximum Charge Current
capabilities.change_summary: Limits the combined battery charge current.

capabilities.title: Maximum Utility Charge Current
capabilities.change_summary: Limits battery charging current drawn from utility.

capabilities.title: Maximum PV Charge Current
capabilities.change_summary: Limits battery charging current drawn from PV.

capabilities.title: Battery Type
capabilities.change_summary: Selects the battery charging profile.

capabilities.title: Battery Capacity
capabilities.change_summary: Sets nominal battery capacity used by the inverter SOC estimate.

capabilities.title: Battery Overcharge Voltage
capabilities.change_summary: Sets the battery overcharge protection threshold.

capabilities.title: Battery Charge Voltage Limit
capabilities.change_summary: Sets the upper battery charging voltage limit.

capabilities.title: Battery Equalization Voltage
capabilities.change_summary: Sets the battery equalization voltage.

capabilities.title: Battery Boost Voltage
capabilities.change_summary: Sets the battery boost/absorption voltage.

capabilities.title: Battery Float Voltage
capabilities.change_summary: Sets the battery float voltage.

capabilities.title: Battery Charge Recovery Voltage
capabilities.change_summary: Sets the boost-charge recovery voltage.

capabilities.title: Battery Undervoltage Recovery
capabilities.change_summary: Sets the voltage at which battery undervoltage clears.

capabilities.title: Battery Undervoltage Alarm
capabilities.change_summary: Sets the low-battery warning voltage.

capabilities.title: Battery Overdischarge Voltage
capabilities.change_summary: Sets the battery overdischarge threshold.

capabilities.title: Battery Discharge Limit Voltage
capabilities.change_summary: Sets the battery discharge cut-off voltage.

capabilities.title: Battery Overdischarge Delay
capabilities.change_summary: Sets the overdischarge protection delay.

capabilities.title: Battery Equalization Time
capabilities.change_summary: Sets battery equalization duration.

capabilities.title: Battery Boost Time
capabilities.change_summary: Sets battery boost/absorption duration.

capabilities.title: Battery Equalization Interval
capabilities.change_summary: Sets the interval between battery equalization cycles.

capabilities.title: Battery Equalization Timeout
capabilities.change_summary: Sets the maximum equalization duration.

capabilities.title: Switch to Utility Voltage
capabilities.change_summary: Sets the battery voltage that transfers the load to utility.

capabilities.title: Return to Inverter Voltage
capabilities.change_summary: Sets the battery voltage that returns the load to inverter.

capabilities.title: Battery Equalization
capabilities.change_summary: Enables periodic battery equalization.

capabilities.title: Power Saving Mode
capabilities.change_summary: Enables low-load search mode.

capabilities.title: Restart on Overload
capabilities.change_summary: Automatically restarts after overload protection.

capabilities.title: Restart on Overtemperature
capabilities.change_summary: Automatically restarts after overtemperature protection.

capabilities.title: Alarm Buzzer
capabilities.change_summary: Enables the inverter alarm buzzer.

capabilities.title: Input Source Change Alarm
capabilities.change_summary: Enables the buzzer when the input source changes.

capabilities.title: Bypass on Overload
capabilities.change_summary: Transfers to bypass when inverter output is overloaded.

capabilities.title: Equalize Battery Now
capabilities.change_summary: Starts or stops an immediate equalization cycle.

capabilities.title: Inverter Power
capabilities.change_summary: Turns inverter operation on or off through the community-documented control register.
